verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains nothing on API keys, role-based privileges, or credential scoping. The Fleet/Elastic Agent items concern telemetry collection agents, not access credentials, and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
